statement: For one frozen release-content digest, compacted-follower snapshot catch-up is integrated through the current production wiring and live safety path, with the complete S1-S6 lineage independently reviewed and no broader recovery claim.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Terminal replay and aggregate review must bind to the exact frozen release-content digest; any shipped snapshot or release-content change invalidates approval.
Closure must trace and independently review the complete S1-S6 lineage, then replay compacted-follower catch-up guards plus current production wiring and live safety evidence.
Do not claim backup, PITR, complete snapshot recovery, or an unrestricted recovery envelope; this Quest covers integrated compacted-follower catch-up only.
